blocks.text: Maison Decision House is a bilingual rehab centre that offers a specialized intensive substance abuse treatment program. This program is designed for individuals who are struggling with moderate to severe alcohol and drug addiction issues. The program provides residents with a structured environment that fosters community development and individual growth. With an eight-week program that utilizes tailored programming based on the social learning theory, MDH provides a unique approach that focuses on unlearning negative habits and developing new thinking and coping skills in residents.
blocks.html: Maison Decision House is a bilingual rehab centre that offers a specialized intensive substance abuse treatment program. This program is designed for individuals who are struggling with moderate to severe alcohol and drug addiction issues. The program provides residents with a structured environment that fosters community development and individual growth. With an eight-week program that utilizes tailored programming based on the social learning theory, MDH provides a unique approach that focuses on unlearning negative habits and developing new thinking and coping skills in residents.

blocks.text: The program consists of five-hour group sessions, five days a week, that focuses on problem-solving, maintenance plans, and goals. The morning session comprises of comprehensive topics relating to substance abuse, while the afternoons offer week-long themed topics such as housing, finances, stress prevention, emotions, leisure, and employment. By providing a structured curriculum that addresses all aspects of addiction recovery, MDH empowers residents to manage their addiction independently. Full-time individual counselling sessions with a primary counsellor offering weekly feedback assist individuals in realizing their progress throughout the program.

blocks.text: Part three of the program focuses on transitioning residents back into society. Aftercare counselling is provided for part three residents and even graduates who have completed the program but are not residing at MDH.

blocks.text: Maison Decision House (MDH) is a reputable rehab centre that has been providing residential treatment programs for adult male offenders since 1979. The organisation upholds the values of inclusivity and diversity by accepting individuals from all walks of life without discrimination. As a non-profit, MDH is committed to providing care, guidance and support to those who seek to overcome addiction and reintegrate into the community. The facility boasts a team of clinical counsellors who are dedicated to ensuring the successful transformation of each resident.

blocks.text: Located in the Hintonburg district of central Ottawa, the facility is conveniently located with easy access to public transportation. It is a large three-story house with two outer buildings serving as a program centre, where up to fourteen residents can be accommodated. MDH operates with a treatment philosophy based on the social learning model, which emphasizes the acquisition of new behavioural skills to replace learnt negative patterns. This approach is tailored to the individual needs of each client, providing customized treatment goals to maximize success. Additionally, the Supervised Apartment is available to residents on full parole or statutory release for a period of up to 90 days as a bridge for reintegration into the community.

centre.about_html:
Maison Decision House is a bilingual rehab centre that offers a specialized intensive substance abuse treatment program. This program is designed for individuals who are struggling with moderate to severe alcohol and drug addiction issues. The program provides residents with a structured environment that fosters community development and individual growth. With an eight-week program that utilizes tailored programming based on the social learning theory, MDH provides a unique approach that focuses on unlearning negative habits and developing new thinking and coping skills in residents.

The program consists of five-hour group sessions, five days a week, that focuses on problem-solving, maintenance plans, and goals. The morning session comprises of comprehensive topics relating to substance abuse, while the afternoons offer week-long themed topics such as housing, finances, stress prevention, emotions, leisure, and employment. By providing a structured curriculum that addresses all aspects of addiction recovery, MDH empowers residents to manage their addiction independently. Full-time individual counselling sessions with a primary counsellor offering weekly feedback assist individuals in realizing their progress throughout the program.

Part three of the program focuses on transitioning residents back into society. MDH offers the opportunity for residents to continue their residency even after completing the program, giving them a structured environment while adjusting to work or school. The staff at MDH evaluates each case individually to ensure that individuals that remain in the program will truly benefit from it. Aftercare counselling is provided for part three residents and even graduates who have completed the program but are not residing at MDH.

Maison Decision House provides a comprehensive program that addresses individuals struggling with substance abuse. Their tailored programming approach has been proven to be highly effective in helping moderate to severe addiction. The unique approach fosters community development and individual growth by providing residents with an environment that promotes positive thinking and habits, geared towards unlearning any negative behaviors. MDH is committed to providing their residents with the resources necessary to manage addiction independently and look forward to a life free from addiction.

Maison Decision House - Center Overview

Maison Decision House (MDH) is a reputable rehab centre that has been providing residential treatment programs for adult male offenders since 1979. The organisation upholds the values of inclusivity and diversity by accepting individuals from all walks of life without discrimination. As a non-profit, MDH is committed to providing care, guidance and support to those who seek to overcome addiction and reintegrate into the community. The facility boasts a team of clinical counsellors who are dedicated to ensuring the successful transformation of each resident.

Located in the Hintonburg district of central Ottawa, the facility is conveniently located with easy access to public transportation. It is a large three-story house with two outer buildings serving as a program centre, where up to fourteen residents can be accommodated. MDH operates with a treatment philosophy based on the social learning model, which emphasizes the acquisition of new behavioural skills to replace learnt negative patterns. This approach is tailored to the individual needs of each client, providing customized treatment goals to maximize success. Additionally, the Supervised Apartment is available to residents on full parole or statutory release for a period of up to 90 days as a bridge for reintegration into the community.

Frequently Asked Questions About Maison Decision House

What is Maison Decision House (MDH)?

MDH is a non-profit organization that offers a community-based residential treatment program for adult male offenders who are returning to the community.

Who is MDH intended for?

MDH is intended for adult male offenders who are returning to the community as a part of their release process, regardless of their race and religion.

What does MDH provide?

MDH provides shelter, guidance, and counselling to adult male offenders who are returning to the community as part of their release process.

How many residents can MDH accommodate?

MDH can accommodate up to fourteen residents.

What is MDH's treatment philosophy?

MDH operates with a general treatment philosophy based on the social learning model, which views addiction as a learned behavior that can be “unlearned” through the development of new patterned thinking and coping skills.

What kind of addiction intervention does MDH provide?

MDH provides addiction intervention to clients who are experiencing alcohol and/or drug abuse problems.

Does MDH offer a Supervised Apartment?

Yes, MDH offers a Supervised Apartment to residents on full parole or statutory release for a period of two months or 90 days as a bridge for reintegration into the community.

raw_html:
Maison Decision House is a bilingual rehab centre that offers a specialized intensive substance abuse treatment program. This program is designed for individuals who are struggling with moderate to severe alcohol and drug addiction issues. The program provides residents with a structured environment that fosters community development and individual growth. With an eight-week program that utilizes tailored programming based on the social learning theory, MDH provides a unique approach that focuses on unlearning negative habits and developing new thinking and coping skills in residents.

The program consists of five-hour group sessions, five days a week, that focuses on problem-solving, maintenance plans, and goals. The morning session comprises of comprehensive topics relating to substance abuse, while the afternoons offer week-long themed topics such as housing, finances, stress prevention, emotions, leisure, and employment. By providing a structured curriculum that addresses all aspects of addiction recovery, MDH empowers residents to manage their addiction independently. Full-time individual counselling sessions with a primary counsellor offering weekly feedback assist individuals in realizing their progress throughout the program.

Part three of the program focuses on transitioning residents back into society. MDH offers the opportunity for residents to continue their residency even after completing the program, giving them a structured environment while adjusting to work or school. The staff at MDH evaluates each case individually to ensure that individuals that remain in the program will truly benefit from it. Aftercare counselling is provided for part three residents and even graduates who have completed the program but are not residing at MDH.

Maison Decision House provides a comprehensive program that addresses individuals struggling with substance abuse. Their tailored programming approach has been proven to be highly effective in helping moderate to severe addiction. The unique approach fosters community development and individual growth by providing residents with an environment that promotes positive thinking and habits, geared towards unlearning any negative behaviors. MDH is committed to providing their residents with the resources necessary to manage addiction independently and look forward to a life free from addiction.

Maison Decision House - Center Overview

Maison Decision House (MDH) is a reputable rehab centre that has been providing residential treatment programs for adult male offenders since 1979. The organisation upholds the values of inclusivity and diversity by accepting individuals from all walks of life without discrimination. As a non-profit, MDH is committed to providing care, guidance and support to those who seek to overcome addiction and reintegrate into the community. The facility boasts a team of clinical counsellors who are dedicated to ensuring the successful transformation of each resident.

Located in the Hintonburg district of central Ottawa, the facility is conveniently located with easy access to public transportation. It is a large three-story house with two outer buildings serving as a program centre, where up to fourteen residents can be accommodated. MDH operates with a treatment philosophy based on the social learning model, which emphasizes the acquisition of new behavioural skills to replace learnt negative patterns. This approach is tailored to the individual needs of each client, providing customized treatment goals to maximize success. Additionally, the Supervised Apartment is available to residents on full parole or statutory release for a period of up to 90 days as a bridge for reintegration into the community.
